$comment: Reference copy of the app configuration as it should be entered in the monday
developer console at https://monday.com/developers/apps. monday does not (yet)
accept a manifest upload for app configuration, so this file is the source of
truth that the console is kept in sync with, and what a reviewer can diff
Scopes are duplicated in src/server/oauth.ts REQUIRED_SCOPES — change both.

app.name: Template Guard
app.tagline: Find what board duplication silently dropped.
app.description: monday drops configuration when you duplicate a board and does not warn you. Template Guard snapshots a template board, compares any copy against it, and shows exactly what is missing, changed, or — most dangerously — still wired to the template's board instead of the copy's.

$scopeRationale.boards:read: Read board structure — columns, groups, views, connections. The comparison is built entirely from this.
$scopeRationale.$boards:write: NOT REQUESTED IN v1. One-click repair is switched off (FEATURE_ONE_CLICK_REPAIR, ADR-025), so Template Guard never writes to a board. The manual repair checklist is unaffected. Re-add this scope only together with that flag.
$scopeRationale.account:read: Account ID and slug, used for deep links into the right monday account and for per-account billing.
$scopeRationale.me:read: Identify the installing user at OAuth time, and record their user id so drift alerts have a recipient (ADR-021).
$scopeRationale.$notRequested: No item, update, or file scopes are requested. Template Guard never reads board items, so it does not hold the permission to.

features.name: Template Guard
features.description: Compare this board against the template it was duplicated from.

features.name: Template Guard status
features.description: Which boards are being watched, and whether any have drifted.

billing.$rationale: The buyer is one ops person administering boards for everyone else. Per-seat pricing on an admin tool makes them justify a bill that scales with colleagues who will never open the app.

plans.name: Free
includes: Every finding at every severity, including mis-wired connect columns
Full manual repair checklist with deep links

plans.name: Pro
includes: Notifications when a board diverges from its template
plans.$constraint: Every Pro capability must be implementable against monday's stable API schema. See ADR-002 and src/billing/tiers.ts.

dataHandling.$note: Enforced at the storage boundary by assertNoItemData() in src/server/storage.ts, not only by policy.

apiVersion.$note: Pinned in exactly one place: src/api/version.ts.

FEATURE_AUTOMATIONS_PREVIEW.$note: Reads board automations via board_automations, which is on monday's preview schema and cannot be version-pinned. Isolated in src/api/preview/automations.ts. No paid feature depends on it. See ADR-002.
